verdict.rationale: Discord documents an App Directory, a searchable hub where users can browse apps by name, category, or collection. These are apps and integrations built to run inside Discord servers, which covers the core of the marketplace story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the install-to-server flow and admin permission controls for adding apps, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
